name: Nekozuka Mike
source:
Each and every day in the Volleyball Club, Mike faces the severe practices of [url=/c98268]Saaya[/url] and [url=/c98282]Kana[/url]. She is very nimble, and instinctively chases round things when she sees them. Mike also has the ability to understand what cats of any size are saying.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
